verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 at https://sam.gov/robots.txt with a standard published crawl policy, and content paths are crawlable to a keyless agent. An agent can therefore read the site's access rules before fetching anything. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation or independent corroboration of the crawl policy, and no detail on the specific directives (e.g., AI-agent-specific rules or a sitemap reference).
